spiritgiven.comments: Such a nice first game! We loved your vibes and how you listened to us during the calls! We thought you were very fair and we motivate you to keep this up!
It was so lovely to play against you! We loved your smiles, your high fives and your communication! Maybe we’ll see each other again in the bracket games ;)

We recommend to you to take a look at the travel rule! We would have loved to give you a 3 in attitude but most of our players felt that the self control part was missing. Great communication keep it up with the translators!

We had the feeling that the body contact during the game was always a bit too much for us. At the peak of the intensity of said contact we felt that you made way too dangerous bids and ended up injuring our players. Afterwards it got better but it was still too physical. Still thank you for this intense game and we loved your high fives on the sideline!

In our opinion even after talking to you in the halftime, none of our mentioned issues improved. You still made unnecessary calls and didn’t listen to us at all. We should have called a spirit timeout but we thought you would act upon our very clear feedback. The amount of calls that we had to contest because we couldn’t do anything else was unacceptable!
The spirit director has more feedback for you!
Thank you for this very spirited and intense game!

spiritreceived.comments: Team Austria was extremely receptive and had very good communication. They made an effort to high five everyone when coming off a point or even just walking down the sideline.

thank you for the great game, we loved your self control and how you managed to discuss and have a positive attitude even if there were some moments were it was difficult to do so. Grazie mille a tutti e buona fortuna!
They were polite, gave it their best, hi fived and kept the spirit up on the sidelines

A really good game, no issues apart from 2 that were noted at half time that we acted on immediately to fix, great talks to resolve calls even with the need of translators at times. Great job Austria!

we think it was a very intense and beautiful game and despite that you managed to keep a good spirit and always be correct and respectful on the calls. We also really loved your smiles on the line and your kindness, thank you❤️
